🧠 Soft Computing Utilities

Java Library for Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic & Neural Networks

A comprehensive, modular Java library implementing soft computing techniques. Perfect for optimization problems, machine learning experiments, and research projects.

  • Genetic Algorithms: Flexible framework with multiple chromosome types, selection strategies, crossover and mutation operators
  • Fuzzy Logic: Complete fuzzy inference system with Mamdani and Sugeno engines
  • Neural Networks: Feed-forward networks integrated with evolutionary algorithms
